target.title: fix(config): cap missing-provider group-policy warning cache with LRU eviction
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes unbounded memory growth in missing-provider group-policy warning deduplication. The `warnedMissingProviderGroupPolicy` Set accumulated every warned `provider:account` pair forever with no eviction, TTL, or size cap. A long-running gateway process that resolves group policy for many missing providers retained entries for every distinct pair that ever triggered the fail-closed fallback warning.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added a 4 096-entry LRU cap with touch-on-read on the private `warnedMissingProviderGroupPolicy` Set. Oldest untouched entries are evicted on overflow; frequently re-warned `provider:account` pairs are promoted to MRU on access. The public `warnMissingProviderGroupPolicyFallbackOnce` API is unchanged — only the private `has`/`add` operations route through the new wrappers.

## User Impact

No change for gateways handling fewer than 4 096 distinct missing-provider `provider:account` pairs — far beyond any realistic deployment. Gateways exceeding the cap may see one extra warning log per evicted entry, a bounded trade-off versus the prior unbounded growth.

## Evidence

### Live proof: cap + eviction + LRU touch

```text
$ pnpm vitest run --project runtime-config --reporter verbose src/config/runtime-group-policy.live-proof.test.ts

stdout | Proof 1 — evicts LRU entry on overflow
  → Cache cap: 4096 entries
  → Seeded 4095 entries (cache at 4095).
  [LOG] provider-cap: channels.provider-cap is missing; defaulting groupPolicy to "allowlist" ...
  [WARN] emitted for provider-cap:account-cap
  → Cache now at cap (4096 entries).
  → Pushed 5 extra entries past the cap.
  [LOG] provider-1: channels.provider-1 is missing; defaulting groupPolicy to "allowlist" ...
  [WARN] emitted for provider-1:account-1
  → "provider-1:account-1" was evicted from cache — re-warning.

stdout | Proof 2 — LRU touch protects frequently accessed keys
  → Seeded 4095 entries.
  → Touched provider-2:account-2 42× (promoted to MRU).
  → Pushed 500 extra entries past the cap.
  → "provider-2:account-2" survived (LRU touch working).

 ✓ Proof 1 — evicts LRU entry on overflow
 ✓ Proof 2 — LRU touch protects frequently accessed keys

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed (2)
   Duration  106ms
```

### Unit tests

```text
$ npx vitest run --project runtime-config src/config/runtime-group-policy.test.ts

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  9 passed (9)
   Duration  131ms
```

- `pnpm oxlint src/config/runtime-group-policy.ts src/config/runtime-group-policy.test.ts` — 0 errors
